entries.speaker: Ann

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: More importantly, you see[n]the survey on there?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno how I feel about it.

entries.uk: Знаєш, а ти таки маєш рацію.
